`scripts/backtest_bugfix_size.py:70`; `src/rebar/_commands/{_seam.py:29, close_precheck.py:28,115, compact.py:48, composer.py:26, composer_edit.py:31, delete.py:32, link_revert.py:26, transition.py:27, transition_close.py:227,296, unlink.py:24, verify_commit.py:25}`; `src/rebar/_engine_support/{commit_impact.py:235, descendants.py:15, field_reads.py:30, lookups.py:15, next_batch.py:27, reads.py:37}`; `src/rebar/_lib_writes.py:329,418`; `src/rebar/audit/read.py:140`; `src/rebar/llm/code_review/{assemble.py:288, bugfix_size_gate.py:185, finalize.py:98, sidecar.py:197,282,323}`; `src/rebar/llm/completion_sidecar.py:260,295,339,406`; `src/rebar/llm/gate_runs.py:170`; `src/rebar/llm/overlap/{digest_sidecar.py:84, queue.py:77}`; `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/sidecar.py:121,171,219,274`; `src/rebar/metrics/blame.py:28`; `src/rebar/review_bot/artifact_emit.py:80`; `src/rebar/signing.py:270`; tests `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/{test_completion_gate.py:29, test_plan_review_gate.py:559,588, test_transition_pre_status_check.py:14, test_transition_reason_honest_3803.py:98}`, `tests/interfaces/store/{test_completion_verifier.py:460, test_sidecar_reader.py:86,105,125,157}`, `tests/scripts/reducer/test_ticket_alias_backfill.py:30`, `tests/unit/test_audit_retention_cap.py:42`, `tests/unit/workflow/{test_completion_token_recovery_heldout.py:127, test_gate_error_sidecar.py:94, test_gate_error_sidecar_heldout.py:67}`.

These are the whole population found by Serena `find_referencing_symbols` on `resolve_ticket_id` plus `git grep -n -E '_engine_support\.resolver|_engine_support import resolver' -- src tests scripts docs`; the module-object, attribute, monkeypatch-string and prose sites are in the description. Note the overlap epic's story granitic-realisable-dolphin deletes `src/rebar/llm/overlap/{digest_sidecar.py, queue.py}`; whichever lands second simply finds those two sites gone.

Plan-review round 1 (2026-09-07, BLOCK) findings folded into this revision: `_replay.py` was wrongly described as already importing from the defining modules; the seven shim consumers among tests and `test_processors_status_split.py` were not scheduled; `test_attach_commits.py:397` has no alias; the AC2 grep was unanchored.
